description: context-6 LTO fx2-cmix top-mixer with xz binary and cmix-compressed dictionary payload
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: The dictionary is decoded by the bundled cmix binary in no-dictionary mode, then the normal dictionary-mode -c/-d path is used. Archive bytes are inherited from fx2_struct_top_mixer_v1 because the decompressed binary and dictionary-mode arguments match.

10m_inherited_from_fx2_struct_top_mixer_.roundtrip_basis: Same decompressed native binary, byte-identical decoded dictionary, same -c/-d dictionary arguments as the direct-verified parent, and byte-identical 1KB archive output.

verdict: Promote as the current best measured 10MB exact-S package. This is a packaging improvement only; it does not change the entropy model.
